trigger.failure: PyTorch AdamW foreach denominator construction requested a full 2.67 GiB exp_avg_sq sqrt tensor with only 2.32 GiB free

root_cause: Moving complete CPU-resident moments to CUDA avoided forward/backward overlap but PyTorch's foreach AdamW still materialized a parameter-sized square-root denominator for the 1.4M by 512 local-code tensor.

followup_failure.failure: discarding the 2.67 GiB local-code gradient with set_to_none required a contiguous reallocation on the next backward

claim_boundary: The chunked optimizer is bitwise equivalent on the fixed unit fixture and the gradient buffer is reused in tests; the real leaves retry must cross step 2 and later step 32/64 before the stage is sealed.
